The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support has

the damage lines up well with the reported impact direction and force. The repair plan
calls for replacing the bumper cover, radiator support, and headlamp assemblies, with
straightening of the core support and refinishing of the hood. The labor hours
requested fit the scope of this work. The billing lines show no duplicate entries.
